assays.assay_description: Observer-scored visual object response (frontal and lateral view) in a 350x350x350 mm black methacrylate chamber at 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240 and 300 min post-injection; arbitrary-unit score; 7 compounds x 5 doses vs vehicle.

setup_restrain.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber (350 x 350 x 350 mm)

food_restriction.evidence: no food in testing chamber described

water_restriction.evidence: no water in testing chamber described

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment (vehicle or 5 doses)

outcomes.summary: All NBOMe, 2C compounds and LSD dose-dependently inhibited visual object response; halogenated derivatives were more potent and faster-acting than 25H-NBOMe and 2C-H. Potency rank: 25I-NBOMe > 25B-NBOMe > 2C-I > LSD > 25H-NBOMe > 2C-B > 2C-H.
outcomes.evidence: -NBOMe, 2C compounds, and LSD inhibit visual object response in mice in a dose-dependent manner; effects of -NBOMe and LSD are faster and stronger than those of 2C compounds.

B1_num_measures.evidence: data are expressed in arbitrary units (visual object response)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: measured 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, and 300 min after injection; time x treatment interaction analysed

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Experiments were conducted in blind by trained observers working together in pairs

E1_environment_type.evidence: experimental chamber (350 x 350 x 350 mm) made with black methacrylate walls and a transparent front door

E3_bedding.evidence: cages were carefully cleaned with a dilute (5%) ethanol solution; no bedding described

E7_social_context.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber

D2_session_duration.evidence: duration of each observation not reported

D3_recording_days.evidence: all timepoints within 5 h after a single injection

D4_baseline.evidence: pre-drug baseline recording not explicitly described

assays.assay_description: Observer-scored visual placing response (animal moving toward surface) at 15, 35, 65, 125, 185, 245 and 305 min post-injection; expressed as % of baseline.

setup_restrain.evidence: procedure details only in Supplementary Material; no restraint described

time_to_assay.evidence: visual placing response was measured at 15, 35, 65, 125, 185, 245, and 305 min

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment; n = 8/group (Figure 3)

outcomes.summary: NBOMe compounds, 2C-I, 2C-B and LSD dose-dependently reduced visual placing; 2C-H was ineffective. 25H-NBOMe was most potent in this test (ED50 0.098 mg/kg), followed by LSD.
outcomes.evidence: Systemic administration of 25H-NBOMe (0.001-10 mg/kg i.p.) reduced in a dose-dependent manner the visual placing response in mice and persisted for up to 5 h at higher doses

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: measured at 15, 35, 65, 125, 185, 245, and 305 min; time effects analysed

D4_baseline.evidence: expressed as % of baseline but pre-drug recording not explicitly described

assays.assay_description: Observer-scored reflex response to four acoustic stimuli of different intensity/frequency produced behind the animal in the 350 mm chamber at 10–300 min post-injection; arbitrary units.

setup_restrain.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment

outcomes.summary: NBOMe and 2C compounds reduced acoustic responses mainly at higher doses with delayed onset; 25I-NBOMe was most potent. LSD did not inhibit acoustic responses and appeared to overexcite mice in the first hour.
outcomes.evidence: When comparing the effects of all compounds, -NBOMe and 2C compounds but not LSD were inhibitory in this test.

B1_num_measures.evidence: data are expressed in arbitrary units (acoustic response)

E7_social_context.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber

assays.assay_description: Observer-scored vibrissae, corneal and pinnae reflexes expressed as summed overall tactile score at 10–300 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber; no restraint described

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment

outcomes.summary: Overall tactile response was unchanged by NBOMe and 2C compounds; LSD produced dose-dependent hyperstimulation of the tactile response.
outcomes.evidence: LSD (0.001-10 mg/kg i.p.) showed a dose-dependent effect of hyperstimulation on the tactile response

B1_num_measures.evidence: Data are expressed as the sum of the three afore-mentioned parameters

assays.assay_description: Mice accustomed 5 min in a 150x150 cm square area, lifted by tail to 3 cm and dropped; latency to first forelimb movement recorded at 15, 40, 70, 130, 190, 250, 310 min post-injection; % of baseline.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were accustomed by placing them in the center of a square area (150 x 150 cm) for 5 min

setup_restrain.evidence: lifted from the tail to 3 cm above the surface and finally dropped. When the animal touched the floor, the latency time for the first movement... was recorded

time_to_assay.evidence: Reaction time and accelerod tests were measured at 15, 40, 70, 130, 190, 250, and 310 min

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment; n = 8/group (Figure 5)

outcomes.summary: Halogenated NBOMes (25I, 25B) markedly increased reaction time, especially in the first hour; 25H-NBOMe only slightly at 1–10 mg/kg; 2C compounds and LSD increased reaction time at higher doses. Reaction time correlated with sensory inhibition.
outcomes.evidence: systemic administration of 25I-NBOMe (0.001-10 mg/kg i.p.) increased the reaction time of the animals, starting at 15 min after administration

B1_num_measures.evidence: the latency time for the first movement of the front limb was recorded

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5 min accustoming then a single drop trial

D4_baseline.evidence: expressed as % of baseline but pre-drug recording not explicitly described

assays.assay_description: Acoustic startle amplitude and %PPI (prepulses 68, 75, 85 dB) in Ugo Basile startle chambers with non-restrictive Perspex holder; tested 15 and 120 min post-injection; NBOMes 0.001–10 mg/kg, 2C and LSD 0.1–10 mg/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: not reported in main text (details in Supplementary Material)

setup_restrain.evidence: holding a transparent non-restrictive Perspex cage (90 x 45 x 50 mm)

time_to_assay.evidence: Effects on PPI are shown... at 15 min after treatment... 120 min after treatment

sample_size.evidence: in the PPI test... eight mice (total mice used: 272) were used for each treatment; figure captions state 'mean ± SEM of 10 animals for each treatment'

outcomes.summary: NBOMes (1–10 mg/kg) and LSD (10 mg/kg) reduced startle amplitude while 2C compounds did not. Halogenated NBOMes and LSD reduced %PPI at low-intermediate doses at 15 and 120 min; 25H-NBOMe only at 1 mg/kg; 2C compounds had minimal effects (2C-B 10 mg/kg at 15 min, 2C-I 10 mg/kg at 120 min).
outcomes.evidence: The present study demonstrates that all hallucinogenic compounds tested reduce the PPI in male mice

B1_num_measures.evidence: Startle magnitude was calculated as the average response to all the pulse-alone trials; % PPI for each prepulse+pulse trial type

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: tested at 15 and 120 min after injection

judge_notes: Adopted the 10-assay granularity of deepseek4/gemma4 (modal): visual object, visual placing, acoustic, tactile, reaction time, grip strength, drag, accelerod, open field, PPI are distinct paradigms; qwen's merged 'Sensorimotor Reflex Battery' and 'Stimulated Motor Activity' were split accordingly.

B1 set to 1 measure (score 0) for single-score tests; gemma's score 1 with value '1' was internally inconsistent and deepseek's '2-3' relied on % of baseline being a separate measure, which it is not.
D3 set to 1 day for all assays (qwen/gemma); deepseek's '2-7' contradicts its own evidence that all timepoints were within one day.

Open field D2 overridden to 61 min–6 h based on Figure 8 caption '4-h observation period'; D1 set to Single session since one continuous 4-h recording per animal was binned (time bins are not separate sessions).
D4 scored 0 throughout: several measures are expressed as '% of baseline' but the main text never explicitly describes a pre-drug recording (details in unavailable Supplementary Material).
setup_restrain: grip strength and drag test = yes (tail-held during measurement, modal); PPI = no ('non-restrictive Perspex cage'), overriding qwen.
PPI sample size: methods state 8/group but figure captions state 10 animals per treatment (df F(5,54) consistent with 10); used lower bound 8 with medium confidence.

Vehicle coded as saline (primary solvent; drugs dissolved in 2% Tween 80 and 5% ethanol brought to volume with saline). n_male left null as total subject counts per sex are not cleanly reported across overlapping cohorts.
